public_statement: Older AP1000 safety-evaluation material can describe the safety-related RNS suction MOV supply as 125 Vdc.
source_locator: NUREG-1793 Supplement 2 Vol.2 §17.6.2 p.17-9 documents the later 125-to-250 Vdc change
remaining_targets: Recover exact pre-change RNS electrical drawing/revision only if needed for design-history reconstruction
do_not_infer: Do not instantiate 125-Vdc safety-related MOV supply in the Revision-19 / Vogtle-3 current model
notes: The explicit NRC change record is sufficient to explain the older/current conflict without treating both voltages as simultaneously applicable.

public_statement: Revision-19 IDS has four independent Class-1E 250-Vdc divisions; Division-B 24-hour battery/MCC load tables include motor-operated valves and the DK-1 MCC family.
source_locator: AP1000 DCD Rev.19 Tier 2 §8.3.2 and Tables 8.3.2-2/-5; NUREG-1793 Supplement 2 design-change history
remaining_targets: Exact V002B motor nameplate voltage; minimum terminal voltage; load current/LRA/FLA; outgoing cubicle/fuse
do_not_infer: 250-Vdc distribution architecture does not by itself prove the actuator motor nameplate is exactly 250 Vdc
notes: Use 250 Vdc as the nominal source/distribution boundary for the V002B power path.

public_statement: Unit-3 IDSB-DK-1 is an installed Class-1E 250-Vdc MCC and is the resolved source-MCC family for the Division-B RNS V002B circuit.
remaining_targets: Current APP-IDSB-E3-DK102/-103 or cross-reference; V002B Appendix-F row; exact cubicle/fuse/branch cable; motor terminal voltage
do_not_infer: Do not copy legacy Rev.2 continuation-sheet branch assignments into current Unit-3 Rev.5/current topology
notes: This is plant-specific corroboration of the Rev.19 250-Vdc architecture.

public_statement: SV3-RNS-EW-PLV002BBXB is publicly documented as a 600-V rated 4/C 240-kcmil cable through P31Y.
remaining_targets: Cable insulation/jacket/manufacturer; conductor material; ORC segment; terminal mapping; route/raceway
do_not_infer: Do not treat 600 V as the V002B motor nominal operating voltage
notes: 600 V is an insulation/rating class for the installed cable, separate from the 250-Vdc source architecture.
